title: Poké Ball Maker
metaTitle: Poké Ball Maker: design your own Poké Ball
metaDescription: Design your own Poké Ball in 3D. Start from an official ball, a type or any Pokémon, then choose colours, patterns, finishes, stickers and an opening effect. Share it or download a PNG, GIF, video, 3D model or 3D-printable STL. Free.
metaDesignDescription: A custom Poké Ball made with the Poké Ball Maker on PokéIQ. Open it to turn it in 3D and watch it open, or design your own.
ogAlt: A custom Poké Ball made on PokéIQ
cardSubtitle: Design your own Poké Ball in 3D.

howto.title: How it works
howto.s1: Pick an official ball, a type theme or a blank ball, roll a random one, or choose any Pokémon to get a ball in its colours and types.
howto.s2: Colour each part, lay patterns over either half, choose a finish for every part (gloss, metal, glass, wood and more), change the shape and the button, and click stickers onto the ball.
howto.s3: Choose an effect that bursts out and a Pokémon to pop out, then press Open, or Catch to see it wobble three times and click.
howto.s4: Your design lives in its link, so anyone can open it. Download a transparent PNG, a GIF, a vertical video, a GLB model or an STL to 3D print.
howto.print: The STL is in millimetres: a 60 mm ball whose halves print flat on their rims without supports, a ring that joins them with 0.25 mm of clearance, and the button in two small pieces. Paint it in your colours.
